bounds.family: ciphertext autokey (union of 0025/0064/0071/0072 tables) and progressive key (0011), 0-2 known letters slipped, or one skipped step (A1.4)
bounds.skip: lag L before the e-th known place, L+1 or L-1 from it, e = 2-24, exact fit
bounds.prog: 8 table classes, periods 1-52, steps 1-25, per letter and per repeat
bounds.controls: 20 shuffled copies (seeds 2130-2149); each plant against 5 shuffles of its own ciphertext
